title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: Your makerspace assistant is on step 2 of a request. The program is about to call the model again. Which statement about what happened in step 1 is true?

options.text: The model still holds step 1 inside itself from its earlier call
The model sees step 1 only if the program sends it again
The model fetches step 1 from the provider's saved history
The model keeps step 1 until the context window is full

items.stem: An assistant request has a fixed overhead (system prompt plus tool definitions) of 1,000 tokens and a student question of 100 tokens. The model requests one tool (50 tokens), whose result is 500 tokens. It then requests a second tool (50 tokens), whose result is 1,500 tokens, and then writes its final answer. Each call re-reads everything before it. How many input tokens are read across all three calls in total?
The makerspace manuals total 400,000 tokens, and the model's context window is 1,000,000 tokens. Your budget is small. Which design is best for answering a question about one machine?

options.text: Put all the manuals in every request, since they fit in the window
Pick the largest model, since recall stays equal at any length
Let the model rewrite the manuals as notes after each visit
Search the manuals and send only the best-matching chunks

items.stem: In one or two sentences: why should a student's laser cutter training status be read from the training database by a tool, rather than only stored in a notes file the model writes?
A question embeds to the vector q = (1, 1) and a manual chunk embeds to c = (1, 0). Compute the cosine similarity of q and c, rounded to two decimal places.
